audit: Android canvas padding independent source/replay/native-pixel audit
scopeNotes: Production sources unchanged. Test-only state/action probe; all shipped production modules execute in the same VM before editor setup.

RGBA and PNG pixels use installed @napi-rs/canvas, not a substitute renderer. Existing native adapter explicitly resets CTM around putImageData to isolate installed-library divergence from browser semantics.
Pure bytes preserve hidden RGB and alpha exactly. Canvas decode/readback can premultiply or discard hidden RGB before padding; no claim of original-file hidden-RGB preservation through Canvas.
80MP retained source path is metadata/controlled decoder testing, not allocation of an 80MP native image.

DOM, decoder completion dispatch, IndexedDB, timers, and Android.saveImage transport are controlled. No real browser/WebView, Android device, APK, SAF gallery save/reopen, model inference, lifecycle/low-memory OS test, EXIF/color-management test, or accessibility gesture verification.
